name: collaborativeconstructionllc-com
_scriptsComment: build cleans _site first. Eleventy passthrough-copy does not remove output for files deleted from source, so without the clean step a deleted asset stays in _site and gets redeployed. That is exactly how a removed 4.1 MB hero video shipped to production after it had been deleted from git.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.jsonc --local
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply cc-leads --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
